scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "red,blue" "npm run dev --prefix oneblood-api" "npm run dev --prefix oneblood-web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix oneblood-api && npm run build --prefix oneblood-web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix oneblood-api && npm run lint --prefix oneblood-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix oneblood-api && npx tsc --noEmit --prefix oneblood-web
